name: borsellino-10-commandments
description: Lewis Borsellino's 10 Commandments of Trading — the discipline framework from the largest S&P pit trader in Chicago history ($4.7M in one day, 10% of S&P volume, 20 years without a losing year). Covers trading for success vs money, discipline, knowing yourself, killing ego, avoiding hope/prayer, letting profits run, knowing when to trade, loving losers, the 3-loss circuit breaker, and the unbreakable rule. Source: Words of Rizdom podcast (March 2026, Arabic dubbed). Use this skill for "Borsellino", "10 commandments", "trading commandments", "trading discipline", "pit trader wisdom", "floor trader rules", "CME floor", "trading ego", "trading psychology rules", "circuit breaker rule", "love your losers", "trade for success not money", "know yourself trading", "Lewis Borsellino". Works with trade-psychology-coach, risk-and-portfolio, trading-fundamentals, trading-plan-builder.
